description: Fetches document metadata and content from Scribd document pages. Attempts multiple access strategies including browser automation and direct HTTP requests to handle Scribd's anti-bot protection.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_document   Fetch document metadata and content from a Scribd URL or document ID
  - extract_tables Extract ranking tables from document content (when table_data is provided)

url.description: Full Scribd document URL (e.g.,  https://www.scribd.com/document/12345/document-title). Required for  get_document function if doc_id is not provided.

doc_id.description: Scribd document ID (e.g., 880794922). Required for get_document function  if url is not provided.

table_data.description: Array of table row objects for processing. Used by extract_tables  function. Each row should have consistent keys representing columns.

max_pages.description: Maximum number of pages to extract content from. Default is all pages. Used by get_document function.
